messages:
dani: introducing Gnocchi the hide-and-seek bunny. he insists on rearranging my sock drawer. pic: https://i.imgur.com/Gnocchi1.jpg :rabbit:
devin: that flop is an absolute binky manifesto. give him snacks immediately. :carrot:
lina: request: can we have a designated "binky break" during demos? productivity will rise 100% (citation: heart).
ioscar: urgent question: does Gnocchi accept pets or only respectful chin scratches? i will travel for chin scratches.
dani: accepts chin scratches but only if preceded by a 3-second dramatic introduction. he will also perform a hop if you bring spinach.
devin: recorded evidence: tiny hop into my lap mid-standup yesterday. sent the clip to #standup-highlights.
ops-bot: reminder: if bringing animals into the office please RSVP in #office-events and confirm no one on the calendar is allergic. :information_source:
lina: tiny poll: should we add a "bring-your-bunny" optional slot to next Friday's social hour? reply yes/no
ioscar: yes. i will bake tiny carrot cupcakes as tribute.
dani: also planning a remote cam setup so remote folks can vote on best binky. will add link to calendar invite if we get enough yes votes.
devin: gif incoming: Gnocchi doing the dramatic flop. caption suggestion: "When the sprint ends but the snack drawer becomes the throne."
lina: PSA: Gnocchi will hide USB sticks in the plant pot. check pockets and planters before panicking about missing dongles.
ioscar: pro tip: never challenge a rabbit's claim on soft surfaces. they will escalate to full-on loaf.
dani: tiny configuration note: to get a guaranteed binky, offer an initial sniff followed by a slow blink. I've tested this extensively.
devin: wild idea: internal badge reward "Binky Approved" for anyone who can get Gnocchi to do a synchronized hop with another pet. team building?
ops-bot: reaction logged :heart_eyes: from 4 users. Please ensure Gnocchi's carrier is secured during transit per pet policy.
dani: final pic: Gnocchi mid-stretch showing off his world domination plan. caption: "Plotting scheduled between 2-3pm, followed by nap." pic: https://i.imgur.com/Gnocchi2.jpg
